We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need leaves commercially available chemicals, total price <= $9999 (we cannot check price but assume typical). Need to construct route using templates.

We have some buyable building blocks: Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride), Nc1ccc(N)cc1 (p-phenylenediamine?), C=CC(=O)Cl (acryloyl chloride). Also Cc1ccc(N)cc1 (p-toluidine) is buyable? Not checked but likely.

Goal: target is a sulfonamide linking a tolyl sulfonyl group to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). Actually structure: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Wait: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N is a cinnamamide with an aniline at the amide nitrogen (anilide with para-amine). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to phenyl (para) which is para to the sulfonamide? Actually NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2: sulfonamide attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl attached to phenyl). That phenyl also has the cinnamamide substituent.

Thus retrosynthesis could break sulfonamide bond to give p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride and aniline (the phenyl-sulfonamide). Also break amide bond to give aniline (aniline with para NH2) and a cinnamic acid derivative (acryloyl chloride). Or break the C=C double bond? But easier: disconnection at sulfonamide and amide.

Step 1: target -> disconnection of sulfonamide: precursor A = p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1) and precursor B = aniline bearing phenyl with cinnamamide (i.e., c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2-NH2). That B is an aniline with the cinnamamide substituent. That B could be made via amide formation between cinnamic acid (or acryloyl chloride) and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Actually the amide is attached to the phenyl ring via carbonyl attached to the phenyl (the amide nitrogen attached to phenyl). Wait: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2: the amide nitrogen attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N). So the amide is formed between cinnamic acid (or acryloyl chloride) and aniline (para-aminophenyl). So B can be made by reacting acryloyl chloride (C=CC(=O)Cl) with p-phenylenediamine (Nc1ccc(N)cc1) to give the cinnamamide with free NH2 on the phenyl (the other amine). That yields the desired B.

Thus overall route:

Step 1: Sulfonylation: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride + B (aniline) -> target (sulfonamide). Template: sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Need template ID. We can search for sulfonamide formation with sulfonyl chloride and amine. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken: ["primary amines"]? Actually we are forming sulfonamide, breaking sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) and amine H. But we can just assume template exists.

Step 2: Amide formation: acryloyl chloride + p-phenylenediamine -> B. Template: acyl chloride + amine -> amide.

Thus total 2 steps.

We need to ensure leaves are commercially available: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (buyable true), acryloyl chloride (buyable true), p-phenylenediamine (Nc1ccc(N)cc1) (buyable true). All good.

Now we need to construct JSON route.

We need template IDs. We can search for template for sulfonamide formation. Use search with functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonamides"] and broken: maybe ["alkyl halide"]? Let's search.
